title: Metron EOD closes (market_data/eod_closes/{run_date,latest}.json, schema_version 1)
description: Producer: collectors/metron_market_data.py::collect_metron_data (CLOSES_SCHEMA_VERSION). Consumer: Metron api/services/*.py, portfolio_analytics/prices/spine_source.py. Plan §3 boundary table row 1.

x-settling-bar.rationale: market_data/eod_closes/{date}.json is one trading day's closes keyed by ticker ($.closes.<ticker>.close / .bar_date); when the key names the report's trading_day the whole document is the unsettled bar. Only NUMERIC value diffs (the close) are absorbed: a differing bar_date or currency is an identity fact graded strictly on the trading day too (alpha-engine-config-I11551 — this declaration hid a D-1 EU bar_date for three days while it absorbed every value diff), and a ticker present on one side only stays a membership breach and still counts against the coverage floor (alpha-engine-config-I11351).
